name: Primary Health Properties Plc
unit: GBP absolute (sterling). The audited group statement prints GBP millions and each figure is multiplied by 1,000,000 here.
source: Primary Health Properties PLC audited group financial statements, Group statement of comprehensive income: FY2025 and FY2024 from the Annual Report 2025 page 121 and the preliminary results statement for the year ended 31 December 2025 page 34; FY2023 from the Annual Report 2024 page 121 comparative column; FY2022 from the preliminary results statement for the year ended 31 December 2022 page 31 comparative column.
note: CRON 2026-11-20: this file previously held a Yahoo Finance column that was wrong in the top half: Revenue printed 224.0 / 93.0 / 65.0 / 85.0 against the audited 259.0 / 181.7 / 169.8 / 154.1, and Operating Expenses 102.0 / 46.0 / 39.0 / 28.0 against the audited 23.0 / 13.9 / 13.7 / 9.6, with five values against four period labels. Every row is now read from the audited statements. Mapping, checked line by line: Revenue is the top rental line the issuer prints (Rental and related income, Rental income in FY2022); Cost of Sales is Direct property expenses; Gross Profit is Net rental and related income; Operating Expenses is Total administrative expenses; Operating Profit (EBIT) is the printed Operating profit; Net Finance Costs is finance costs plus the fair value loss on derivative swaps and the convertible bond, plus exceptional loan fees and early termination costs, less finance income, so that Operating profit less Net Finance Costs equals the printed Profit before taxation in all four years; Income Tax is the printed Taxation charge (a credit of 1.2 in FY2023); Net Profit is Profit after taxation; EPS is the printed IFRS basic earnings per share in pounds (6.6p, 3.1p, 2.0p, 4.2p). Checks: 259 less 27 equals 232; 221 less 99 equals 122; 122 less 3 equals 119. FY2024: 181.7 less 26.0 equals 155.7; 103.4 less 56.4 equals 47.0; 47.0 less 5.6 equals 41.4. FY2023: 169.8 less 18.8 equals 151.0; 84.3 less 58.2 equals 26.1; 26.1 plus 1.2 equals 27.3. FY2022: 154.1 less 12.6 equals 141.5; 70.4 less 13.5 equals 56.9; 56.9 less 0.6 equals 56.3.
